verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator, and user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a workflow-product axis, not one that applies to this kind of hardware. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD shipping such a rules engine: the Prometheus metrics exporter and the Spur job scheduler are adjacent building blocks, not event-rule automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
